stories.h: Wet, windy weekend ahead; flood watch for Mason County
stories.s: After a mild Thursday, rain and stronger winds return Friday, with beach gusts topping 50 mph. A flood watch covers Mason County from early Friday to early Sunday, with the Skokomish River at risk.

stories.h: San Juan County declares emergency over Orcas ferry dock
stories.s: Cracked steel beams at the Orcas Island ferry terminal limit loading to vehicles 22 feet or shorter. Repairs could take up to two weeks, and the county is asking the state for help.

stories.h: Mill Creek bridge closes this weekend for emergency repairs
stories.s: 164th Street SE over North Creek near SR 527 closes both ways from 9 p.m. Friday to 4 a.m. Monday after a support column failed. Expect detours via North Road and 10 to 15 minute delays.

stories.h: Leaders gather near Cle Elum to plan for next fire season
stories.s: Officials and industry leaders met in Kittitas County to plan after a devastating fire year, discussing home hardening, burying power lines and fuel-reduction crews.

talking.h: Kraken face Hurricanes in Helsinki this morning
talking.s: Puck drops at 9 a.m. Pacific in Seattle's first overseas game, against the league-leading Hurricanes. Four Finnish Kraken players get a homecoming.

talking.h: Seahawks' defense draws rookie Mendoza's first start
talking.s: Las Vegas hands No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza his first career start Sunday against Seattle, which again turns to Drew Lock with Sam Darnold out.

talking.h: Mariners reportedly eye free-agent outfielder Ian Happ
talking.s: MLB Network's Jon Morosi reports Seattle is interested in Happ, the former Cubs Gold Glove left fielder, as a cheaper outfield option.

coming.h: Kraken vs. Hurricanes, Game 2 in Helsinki
coming.s: Second of two Global Series games in Finland; Carolina is the designated home team.

coming.h: Seahawks at Raiders in Las Vegas
coming.s: Seattle (5-4) plays its last game before the bye against rookie QB Fernando Mendoza.

coming.h: State revenue forecasters meet ahead of budget session
coming.s: The Economic and Revenue Forecast Council holds its November revenue review, a key number for lawmakers facing a budget shortfall.
coming.src: WA Economic and Revenue Forecast Council
